name: ROTCE (excluding significant items)
definition: Return on tangible common equity as reported by the firm for the quarter, excluding the significant items noted in the presentation.

name: Standardized CET1 ratio
definition: Standardized common equity tier 1 capital ratio at quarter end, as stated on the call.

name: NII excluding Markets outlook
definition: Full-year 2026 net interest income excluding Markets, as guided on the call; raised from $95 billion.

name: Adjusted expense outlook
definition: Full-year 2026 adjusted expense outlook as guided on the call, raised by $2.5 billion during the quarter.

name: Card net charge-off rate outlook
definition: Full-year 2026 Card Services net charge-off rate the firm now expects, reflecting better-than-expected consumer credit performance.

name: AWM long-term net inflows
definition: Long-term net inflows into Asset & Wealth Management during the quarter, as stated on the call.

name: Assets under management
definition: Asset & Wealth Management assets under management at quarter end, as stated on the call.
